description: This script automates end-to-end testing and management of a Windows Parallels VM environment, including snapshot management, software installation, onboard procedures, and status verification for openclaw components. It includes functions for VM control, network setup, software deployment via HTTP server, and orchestrates a sequence of testing steps for 'fresh' or 'upgrade' modes.

methods.name: resolve_snapshot_info
methods.description: Detects and matches a snapshot in Parallels VM based on a fuzzy/hint-based comparison.

methods.name: resolve_host_ip
methods.description: Determines the host IP address for VM connection, either from parameter or autodetects.

methods.name: resolve_host_port
methods.description: Allocates a free TCP port for hosting the HTTP server for deployment.

methods.name: guest_exec
methods.description: Executes a command inside the VM via prlctl.

methods.name: host_timeout_exec
methods.description: Executes a command with a specified timeout on the host machine.

methods.name: guest_powershell
methods.description: Runs a PowerShell script inside the VM.

methods.name: guest_run_openclaw
methods.description: Runs an openclaw command inside the VM with specific environment variables.

methods.name: ensure_vm_running_for_retry
methods.description: Ensures that the VM is in a running state, resuming or starting if needed.

methods.name: run_windows_retry
methods.description: Retries VM commands multiple times with delays.

methods.name: restore_snapshot
methods.description: Restores a VM snapshot by ID.

methods.name: verify_windows_user_ready
methods.description: Checks if Windows user environment inside VM is ready.

methods.name: wait_for_vm_status
methods.description: Waits for the VM to reach a specified state (e.g., stopped, running).

methods.name: wait_for_guest_ready
methods.description: Polls until Windows guest inside VM is ready.

methods.name: phase_log_path
methods.description: Generates path for phase-specific log files.

methods.name: show_log_excerpt
methods.description: Displays the last 80 lines of a log file for diagnostic purposes.

methods.name: phase_run
methods.description: Runs a phase command with timeout, capturing logs and handling errors.

methods.name: extract_last_version
methods.description: Parses logs to find the last version string of openclaw.

methods.name: write_summary_json
methods.description: Creates a JSON summary report of test results and environment.

methods.name: resolve_latest_version
methods.description: Fetches the latest openclaw version from npm registry if not specified.

methods.name: resolve_mingit_download
methods.description: Obtains download info for MinGit from GitHub latest release.

methods.name: current_build_commit
methods.description: Reads current build commit hash from local build info JSON.

methods.name: acquire_build_lock
methods.description: Creates a lock directory to prevent concurrent builds.

methods.name: release_build_lock
methods.description: Removes the build lock directory.

methods.name: ensure_current_build
methods.description: Ensures that the build artifacts correspond to the current HEAD commit.

methods.name: ensure_guest_git
methods.description: Checks for Git inside VM and installs MinGit if absent.

methods.name: pack_main_tgz
methods.description: Packages current main or target npm package into a tarball, optionally including a git commit info.

methods.name: verify_target_version
methods.description: Validates that the installed version matches expected target version.

methods.name: start_server
methods.description: Starts an HTTP server to serve the main package tarball for VM installation.

methods.name: install_latest_release
methods.description: Downloads and installs the latest openclaw release inside the VM.

methods.name: install_main_tgz
methods.description: Downloads and installs the packaged main tarball inside the VM.

methods.name: verify_version_contains
methods.description: Checks that the openclaw version string includes a specific substring.

methods.name: write_onboard_runner_script
methods.description: Creates a PowerShell script to run onboard steps inside the VM.

methods.name: run_ref_onboard
methods.description: Runs the onboard process in ref-mode inside the VM.

methods.name: verify_gateway
methods.description: Verifies that the gateway is responsive and working inside the VM.

methods.name: run_gateway_daemon_action
methods.description: Runs start/stop/restart commands for the gateway daemon inside the VM.

methods.name: restart_gateway
methods.description: Restarts the gateway daemon.

methods.name: stop_gateway
methods.description: Stops the gateway daemon.

methods.name: show_gateway_status_compat
methods.description: Displays gateway status with backward compatibility handling.

methods.name: verify_turn
methods.description: Performs a test turn to verify if components are responsive.

methods.name: capture_latest_ref_failure
methods.description: Attempts onboard in ref-mode, flags failure if it occurs.

methods.name: run_fresh_main_lane
methods.description: Executes sequence for a fresh VM environment test.

methods.name: run_upgrade_lane
methods.description: Performs sequence for upgrading existing environment.
